    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">常用设计模式：模板方法模式</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="引言">引言</h2>
<p>模板方法模式（Template Method Pattern）是一种行为型设计模式。它定义算法骨架，将具体步骤延迟到子类实现。适用于固定流程但部分步骤可变的情景，如游戏初始化或数据处理。</p>
<h2 id="定义">定义</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>抽象类</strong>：定义模板方法（final方法）和抽象步骤。</li>
<li><strong>具体子类</strong>：实现抽象步骤。</li>
</ul>
<p>优点：代码复用，易扩展。缺点：子类过多时复杂。</p>
<div class="mermaid">classDiagram
    class Beverage {
        +prepare(): void
        +boilWater(): void
        +pourInCup(): void
        +brew(): void abstract
        +addCondiments(): void abstract
    }
    class Coffee {
        +brew(): void
        +addCondiments(): void
    }
    class Tea {
        +brew(): void
        +addCondiments(): void
    }
    Beverage &lt;|-- Coffee
    Beverage &lt;|-- Tea
</div><h2 id="typescript-示例">TypeScript 示例</h2>
<p>假设实现饮料冲泡流程。</p>
<h3 id="类实现">类实现</h3>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">// 抽象类
abstract class Beverage {
  // 模板方法
  prepare(): void {
    this.boilWater();
    this.brew();
    this.pourInCup();
    this.addCondiments();
  }

  boilWater(): void {
    console.log("煮沸水");
  }

  abstract brew(): void; // 抽象步骤

  pourInCup(): void {
    console.log("倒入杯中");
  }

  abstract addCondiments(): void; // 抽象步骤
}

// 具体子类：咖啡
class Coffee extends Beverage {
  brew(): void {
    console.log("冲泡咖啡");
  }

  addCondiments(): void {
    console.log("加糖和奶");
  }
}

// 具体子类：茶
class Tea extends Beverage {
  brew(): void {
    console.log("浸泡茶叶");
  }

  addCondiments(): void {
    console.log("加柠檬");
  }
}

// 使用
const coffee = new Coffee();
coffee.prepare(); // 输出：煮沸水 冲泡咖啡 倒入杯中 加糖和奶

const tea = new Tea();
tea.prepare(); // 输出：煮沸水 浸泡茶叶 倒入杯中 加柠檬
</code></pre>
<p><code>prepare()</code> 是模板方法，固定流程。子类重写 <code>brew()</code> 和 <code>addCondiments()</code>，不改整体结构。</p>
<h3 id="函数式实现">函数式实现</h3>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">// ======================
// Step 1: 定义策略函数类型
// ======================

type BrewFunction = () =&gt; void;
type AddCondimentsFunction = () =&gt; void;

// ======================
// Step 2: 固定步骤函数
// ======================

const boilWater = (): void =&gt; {
  console.log("🔥 Boiling water...");
};

const pourInCup = (): void =&gt; {
  console.log("🥛 Pouring into cup...");
};

// ======================
// Step 3: 模板方法（高阶函数）
// ======================

const makeDrink =
  (brew: BrewFunction, addCondiments: AddCondimentsFunction) =&gt;
  (): void =&gt; {
    console.log("\n🧪 Starting to make a drink...\n");

    boilWater();           // 固定
    brew();                // 可变
    pourInCup();           // 固定
    addCondiments();       // 可变

    console.log("\n✅ Drink is ready!\n");
  };

// ======================
// Step 4: 策略实现（不同饮料）
// ======================

// Coffee
const brewCoffee: BrewFunction = () =&gt; {
  console.log("☕ Brewing coffee grounds...");
};

const addSugarAndMilk: AddCondimentsFunction = () =&gt; {
  console.log("🍬 Adding sugar and milk...");
};

// Tea
const brewTea: BrewFunction = () =&gt; {
  console.log("🍵 Steeping the tea...");
};

const addLemon: AddCondimentsFunction = () =&gt; {
  console.log("🍋 Adding a slice of lemon...");
};

// ======================
// Step 5: 组合并执行
// ======================

const makeCoffee = makeDrink(brewCoffee, addSugarAndMilk);
makeCoffee();

const makeTea = makeDrink(brewTea, addLemon);
makeTea();
</code></pre>
<h2 id="真实案例">真实案例</h2>
<p>下面列举了 3 个真实开源仓库，包含明确的“模板方法模式（Template Method Pattern）”逻辑。</p>
<h3 id="apache-kafkajava">Apache Kafka（Java）</h3>
<p>Kafka 的 复制（Replica / Fetcher / LogCleaner）流程大量使用模板方法模式。</p>
<p>模板方法骨架，文件：AbstractFetcherThread.java</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public abstract class AbstractFetcherThread extends ShutdownableThread {
    @Override
    public void doWork() {
        Map&lt;TopicPartition, FetchData&gt; fetched = fetchData();  // 模板步骤
        processFetchedData(fetched);                           // 模板步骤
        maybeThrottle();
    }

    protected abstract Map&lt;TopicPartition, FetchData&gt; fetchData();
    protected abstract void processFetchedData(Map&lt;TopicPartition, FetchData&gt; fetched);
}
</code></pre>
<p>子类实现步骤，示例：ReplicaFetcherThread.java</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Override
protected Map&lt;TopicPartition, FetchData&gt; fetchData() {
    // 从 leader 拉取日志
}

@Override
protected void processFetchedData(Map&lt;TopicPartition, FetchData&gt; fetched) {
    // 写入本地日志副本
}
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>doWork() 是固定流程（骨架）</li>
<li>fetchData()、processFetchedData() 由子类决定</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="spring-framework--spring-aop">Spring Framework / Spring AOP</h3>
<p>Spring AOP 的拦截器链实现中大量使用模板方法结构。</p>
<p>模板方法骨架，文件：AbstractPlatformTransactionManager.java</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public final TransactionStatus getTransaction(TransactionDefinition definition) {
    Object transaction = doGetTransaction();            // 模板步骤
    boolean newTx = shouldStartTransaction(...);      
    if (newTx) {
        doBegin(transaction, definition);               // 模板步骤
    }
    return prepareTransactionStatus(...);
}

protected abstract Object doGetTransaction();
protected abstract void doBegin(Object transaction, TransactionDefinition definition);
</code></pre>
<p>子类实现步骤，示例：DataSourceTransactionManager.java</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Override
protected Object doGetTransaction() {
    return new DataSourceTransactionObject();
}

@Override
protected void doBegin(Object transaction, TransactionDefinition definition) {
    // 开启 JDBC 事务
}
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><code>getTransaction()</code> 定义统一事务开启流程</li>
<li>某些步骤由子类实现（JDBC, JPA, Hibernate 都不一样）</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="medusajs">Medusa.js</h3>
<p>Medusa 是一个基于 TypeScript 的电商框架，批量任务、支付、库存策略等通过抽象基类强制子类实现步骤。</p>
<p>模板方法骨架，文件：AbstractBatchJobStrategy.ts</p>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">
export abstract class AbstractBatchJobStrategy {
  async prepareBatchJob(batchJob: BatchJob): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
    await this.preProcessBatchJob(batchJob);   // 模板步骤
    await this.processJob(batchJob);           // 模板步骤
    await this.postProcessBatchJob(batchJob);  // 模板步骤
  }

  protected abstract preProcessBatchJob(job: BatchJob): Promise&lt;void&gt;;
  protected abstract processJob(job: BatchJob): Promise&lt;void&gt;;
  protected abstract postProcessBatchJob(job: BatchJob): Promise&lt;void&gt;;
}
</code></pre>
<p>子类实现步骤，示例：ProductImportStrategy.ts</p>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">export class ProductImportStrategy extends AbstractBatchJobStrategy {
  protected async preProcessBatchJob(job) { ... }
  protected async processJob(job) { ... }
  protected async postProcessBatchJob(job) { ... }
}
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>基类定义“批处理任务生命周期流程”</li>
<li>子类完成具体逻辑</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="结语">结语</h2>
<p>模板方法模式提升代码可维护性，适用于框架设计。</p>

</div>
